description: Objects with different attributes, one the null keyword, unify keeping the selected values
notes: hashicorp/hcl unifies objects with different attribute names to a map of their unified attribute types, here a map of strings, which the object holding null converts to only unsafely (unifyObjectTypesToMap in cty/convert/unify.go). The spec gives an object type with both attributes. Either way attribute a of the selected object is "x".
